channel.title: Wire — Databases
channel.description: Databases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: We replaced Redis with MySQL for inventory reservations and it scaled
item.description: How we used SKIP LOCKED, composite primary keys, and connection visibility to hit our scale targets. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Andy Pavlo joins ClickHouse to establish ClickHouse Labs
item.description: I am excited to announce that I am joining ClickHouse, Inc. to establish and lead a new research team at ClickHouse Labs. (2 sources: hackernews, postgresweekly)

item.title: Stripe Uses Graph Search and State Machines to Automate Database Remediation
item.description: The engineering team at Stripe recently described how they automated database incident recovery by modeling their global infrastructure as a graph. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Making Postgres 300x faster for analytics: batching, operator fusion, and SIMD
item.description: Last week we released version 0.2 of pgrust. This release was all about performance. It’s 10x faster than the previous version of pgrust. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: COUNT(DISTINCT) Too Slow? A Guide to Fast Approximations
item.description: Learn how to replace slow Postgres COUNT(DISTINCT) queries using TABLESAMPLE, HyperLogLog, and Apache DataSketches for sub-millisecond analytics. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Model the Cost of an Oracle-To-Postgres Move
item.description: This calculator provides an estimate for savings by migrating from Oracle to Postgres®. Please provide specific input in the steps below to calculate your estimated savings. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: SQL Improvements in Postgres 11–18: A Personal Selection
item.description: Seven major versions of PostgreSQL shipped between 2018 and 2025, one per year without exception, and each with a changelog of 150 to 200 user-visible changes. … (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Unveiling a 13-Year-Old Postgres Bug in Cascading Replication
item.description: Discover how using CloudNativePG on Kubernetes revealed a 13-year-old bug in PostgreSQL's streaming replication code, set for remediation in upcoming releases. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: 'Turning Claude into Postgres So I Can Raise a Series A'
SQLite Critical CVEs or LLM Slop?
item.description: The JFrog security research team recently identified a supply chain attack targeting the `xinference` package on PyPI. Versions 2.6.0, 2.6.1, and 2.6.2 were compromised and yanked by maintainers after users reported suspicious behavior. (1 source: hackernews)
